what: MONITORING read of the registered prefix-matching score at a reduced sequence count. NOT the registered measurement.
why_reduced: machine load average was above 100 from unrelated projects and the registered count did not complete. n_sequences is exposed by interp.py as a cost knob and changes no definition: same make_copy_sequences construction, same seed, same prefix_matching_indices pairs, same repeat_len 128.
reading: At 40,009,728 tokens the maximum prefix-matching score is 0.09613, which is 17.8 times chance and immediately below the registered phase-change lower bound of 0.1. At 8,011,776 tokens it is 0.01139, 2.1 times chance and at floor. The signal is concentrated in layers 4 to 7 (0.0352, 0.0961, 0.0529, 0.0657) against layers 0 to 3 at or near chance, which is where induction heads are expected to sit.
caveats: 8 sequences, not the registered 256. Adequate to separate 0.096 from chance 0.0054, not adequate for a reported figure.

abl_lr1.2e-3 decays its learning rate cosine to 10 percent by 40M tokens, while Stage A holds 1.2e-3 constant. The ablation run is therefore a CONSERVATIVE proxy: a constant-rate run should reach a given point no later.
The two checkpoints come from two different runs. Only the 8,011,776-token one is Stage A.
Superseded for any reported number by the registered-count sweep.

import importlib.util, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np, torch
from small_lm_lab import interp
from small_lm_lab.config import get_config
REPO = Path("$SMALL_LM_LAB_REPO")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("es", REPO/"scripts"/"06_evaluate.py")
es = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(es)
cfg = get_config("size30m")
N = 8
for name in ["abl_lr1.2e-3/tokens_000040009728.pt", "size30m_staged_seed1/tokens_000008011776.pt"]:
    p = Path("$SMALL_LM_LAB_BULK_ROOT/checkpoints")/name
    t0=time.time(); model, tokens = es.load_model(cfg, p, "cpu")
    pm = interp.prefix_matching_per_sequence(model, "cpu", n_sequences=N, batch_size=4).mean(0)
    l,h = np.unravel_index(int(pm.argmax()), pm.shape)
    print(f"{name}\n  tokens {tokens:,}  max prefix-matching {pm.max():.5f} at layer {l} head {h}"
          f"  [chance 0.00541]  heads>0.2: {int((pm>0.2).sum())}  ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)")
    print("  per-layer max: " + " ".join(f"L{i}:{v:.4f}" for i,v in enumerate(pm.max(1))))
    sys.stdout.flush()
